generation.scope: Pure-relation-free branching without surfaces requires opposite rank at least eleven. Opposite forward and backward centers have successor and predecessor lines meeting at one point. Their marked row spaces meet in one rank-one matrix; at rank eleven their sum is the full perpendicular of the crossing point and the resulting quotient bundle has splitting (2,1,1).
